name: Glint Flickthrow
description: Throw from a high elbow with the second hand held low so both tracks are ready at once.

name: Lodgewrath
description: Flick the low-hand blade at the ankle while the high hand keeps its aim on the throat.

name: Shivflash
description: Cross the lead foot over the rear while the guard knife covers the line of the throwing arm.

name: Merciless Pointguard
description: Send a separate pulse of qi down each arm so both blades leave with different spins.

name: Shivvalor
description: Throw a blade so its shadow falls where the foe expects it then land the true one beside.

name: Spineweight Fortitude
description: Knock a cut aside with the guard knife and dive the throwing blade into the opening it leaves.

name: Stickwrath
description: Drive two qi-wrapped blades from above in one dive so the second follows the first through the same wound.

name: Charter Balanceblade
description: Cast blades from both hands to stand in two rails of steel that hold a lane shut.

name: Bladeflat Devastation
description: Rise on qi to the peak of a leap and rain both tracks of blades across the whole foe's front.

name: Might Edgeflat
description: Hold both knives at matching height and breathe level with the arms still so the pair cast as one.

name: Hoarfrost Lodge
description: Throw the left blade then the right in even beats at marks on either side of the foe.

name: Rumble Flight
description: Snap the second wrist the moment the first blade leaves so the second flies as its answer.

name: Waning Throwtang
description: Take one level glance across the field to see where both blades will fall before releasing.

name: Merciless Hiltweight
description: Throw both blades on curving paths that cross in front of the foe at a single point.

name: Leanmettle
description: Meet an incoming dart with one blade and send both blades back along the line it came by.

name: Hoarfrost Spinetip
description: Pin both sleeves of a foe to the post behind with matched blades thrown from either side.

name: Thunkwrath
description: Hold two counterposed streams of blades over a broad front so the foe is pinned between them.

name: Facetshiv
description: Mark the foe in the qi field and throw one blade each side so both strike at the same moment.

name: Glintslim
description: Send two blades that each see the other's path and strike one wound from opposite angles.

name: Blaze Throwgrip
description: Open the run with a light toss that sets the rhythm of the stream of throws to come.

name: Illuminating Spinetip
description: Turn in a small circle as a fresh blade slides into the hand so the run does not pause.

name: Gust Thunk
description: Slide along one line and cast at the end of each slide like a river against its bank.

name: Silt Weighttang
description: Step in short fords of three paces and throw on the breath at the end of each crossing.

name: Nova Hiltweight
description: Throw in a slow even current where each blade is released only as the last one lands.

name: Intent Lodge
description: Overlap casts so the next blade leaves before the last one has landed in an unbroken stream.

name: Gust Bladeflat
description: Bend the flow of a stream of blades round a raised guard so it meets the unguarded flank.

name: Fastening Pointguard
description: Pull the stream back on the cord so a pinned foe is dragged hard against the post.

name: Mayhem Weighttang
description: Pour a torrent of thrown blades down a lane so the whole width is swept at once.

name: Stick Scourge
description: Curve a stream of blades round the foe and back so each pass cuts a new angle.

name: Dismantling Balanceblade
description: Gather every blade at the bank then loose them in one great flood across the foe's whole front.

name: Discerning Throwgrip
description: Throw a single measuring blade to mark the far limit of the field before the real cast.

name: Rumble Thunk
description: Throw high overhand under an open sky so the blade rises and falls onto a distant mark.

name: Might Throwtang
description: Gather the breath and qi to the shoulder in one slow count so the long throw has full force.

name: Might Flickthrow
description: Walk back one pace at a time while the foe closes so the exact reach is kept.

name: Spinthrow Valor
description: Throw from far off so the blade lands at a foe's heels and pins a trailing cloak to the ground.

name: Leanruin
description: Throw with the field stretched so the blade glides flat over the full width of the far field.

name: Merciless Spineweight
description: Loft a volley high so the blades fall from above onto a foe who is guarding at the front.

name: Decimating Edgeflat
description: Fix on one far mark and send a single blade through the guard that stands before it.

name: Stick Devastation
description: Throw from the edge of seeing so the foe never learns where the blade came from.

name: Fastening Spinthrow
description: Pin a foe at the far reach with three blades that lock his cloak and legs to the ground.

name: Hour Bladeflat
description: Rain marked blades across the full reach so any who move within the span are struck.

name: Unsparing Throwtang
description: Send one blade the full extent of the field so it lands from beyond the reach of any guard.

name: Equipoise Spinetip
description: Palm the blade flat against the wrist so the second edge cannot be seen from the front.

name: Murkflight
description: Throw a plain blade first so the foe tracks it while the second edge is already loosed.

name: Nova Pointguard
description: Turn the wrist at release so the blade takes a flatter path than the eye expects.

name: Throwgrip Rocketry
description: Sweep the lead foot aside in silence so the second edge leaves from an unexpected place.

name: Vengeful Edgeflat
description: Flick on a held breath so the first edge flies and the second hangs ready in the fingers.

name: Gust Hiltweight
description: Cast a second blade so closely behind the first that the foe sees one flight and takes two.

name: Gust Balanceblade
description: Meet a strike with the open blade while the concealed edge cuts the striker's wrist.

name: Spineweight Valor
description: Cast the hidden edge into a foe's sleeve at the moment he reaches to deflect the first.

name: Murkstick
description: Weave two flight paths in a braid so the foe cannot tell which blade is the true cut.

name: Nova Stick
description: Send two edges into the same seam of armor so the second finds the gap the first made.

name: Slimspine
description: Cast two paths of blades to lodge in a lattice with the second path unseen until crossed.

name: Gyveflight
description: Pin the foe's visible guard with the first edge and the arm behind it with the hidden second.

name: Streaking Spinthrow
description: Flash a pace forward in step with the cast so the second edge lands as the first is parried.

name: Verity Weighttang
description: Take a stance at a height and sweep the ground for the single foe whose fall decides the fight.

name: Slimhavoc
description: Throw straight down from the court gallery with the elbow locked so the blade falls true.

name: Slimglare
description: Land from a height in a short roll and rise with the throwing hand already free.

name: Chime Thunk
description: Brace the forearm on a rail and release along it so the aim is absolutely steady.

name: Stick Reckoning
description: Throw from far above with a qi weight so the blade gains speed in its long fall.

name: Charter Lodge
description: Fix a gaze on one foe so that others feel passed over and the chosen one feels it too.

name: Vital Spineweight
description: Fold into a dive from the rail and take a fresh blade from the thigh strap on the way down.

name: Thorn Hiltweight
description: Throw a spread of corded blades from a height that settles over a foe like a falling net.

name: Intent Throwgrip
description: Mark several foes from the height then loose a blade at each in one quick order.

name: Grievous Thunk
description: Choose the one foe whose fall ends the fight and drop a single blade on him from the height.

name: Remnant Pointguard
description: Wet a finger and read the wind's direction and strength before the oath word is spoken.

name: Chime Edgeflat
description: Throw on a full arm sweep along the plateau top with the wind a hand off the line.

name: Gustflight
description: Lean on a marker stone and set the feet along the bearing before each long cast.

name: Hoarfrost Throwtang
description: Loose in the lull between two gusts so the blade is not turned off by the next one.

name: Obdurate Balanceblade
description: Brace the guard arm into the wind to turn a thrown stone or blade aside from the chest.

name: Shivwrath
description: Throw high on a rising gust so the wind carries the blade farther than any arm could.

name: Flighthavoc
description: Drive the blade low into a headwind with qi so it keeps its force and bores through cloth.

name: Facet Bladeflat
description: Skip a blade off a ridge in the wind so it rises into a foe sheltering behind it.

name: Shade Flickthrow
description: Spread a volley that bends with the crosswind so it covers a wide arc of the plateau.

name: Wicked Throwtang
description: Cast blades to stand upright in a line along the wind so any who cross are cut.

name: Punishing Flickthrow
description: Speak the wind oath and loose a single long throw that the wind itself drives home.

name: Flightglare
description: Plant both feet on the oath stone of the plateau and root the weight through the heels.

name: Shattering Flight
description: Throw from the high rim along the sight line with no arc and no hesitation.

name: Stickruin
description: Speak the pledge as the blade is drawn and throw before the last word has left the lips.

name: Unbowed Spinetip
description: Ring the guard arm with qi so that a blow glances off and the arm is free to throw.

name: Rumbleslim
description: Bind the oath to the flight so the blade bends back toward its mark if the aim slips.

name: Lodgedurance
description: Pin the foe's weapon arm with the sworn blade so he cannot draw until the oath is released.

name: Granite Spinthrow
description: Sweep the plateau with sworn blades in a broad arc so none may cross without a cut.

name: Tempered Flight
description: Anchor the stance on the rim and throw with the oath's full weight through a guard.

name: Decimating Thunk
description: Cast a single blade that cannot be turned aside while the oath-taker still stands.

name: Weighttang Vitality
description: Turn the face to the gale and learn its pulse in the first three breaths of the fight.

name: Glint Edgeflat
description: Hurl the blade downslope with the wind at the back so it gains speed over a long fall.

name: Facet Pointguard
description: Count the gusts and throw on the slack beat when the air lies flat.

name: Obdurate Hiltweight
description: Let the cloak fly out in the gale to snag a thrown blade and turn it from the chest.

name: Silt Lodge
description: Slide with the gale at the back to cover ground between casts without losing balance.

name: Blaze Weighttang
description: Throw low so the gale pushes the blade skimming over the ground into the foe's legs.

name: Mayhemlean
description: Spin a blade past the foe's face so the gale's whip of it startles his guard open.

name: Intent Spineweight
description: Throw upwind and let the gale's swing bring the blade back to the thrower's waiting hand.

name: Flight Scourge
description: Spread three blades on the gale so the wind fans them across the foe upper body.

name: Corroding Stick
description: Throw so the gale curves the blade after a fleeing foe and brings it onto his back.

name: Ponderous Bladeflat
description: Pin the foe's cloak and boots with blades carried on the gale to different points at once.

name: Tempered Lodge
description: Let the gale lift one blade from the hand and place it exactly where the reading says.

name: Daybreak Spinetip
description: Stand in the open with no cover and let the stance itself tell the foe that retreat is not planned.

name: Glint Spinthrow
description: Pace the open ground then throw at the exact distance paced with no arc correction.

name: Weighttang Flash
description: Step back only the single pace needed to keep the foe at the thrown distance.

name: Hoarfrost Throwgrip
description: Sweep the open hand wide and cast low so no ground nearby is safe to stand on.

name: Shivruin
description: Throw at a foe on the skyline so the blade is seen only as a glint before it lands.

name: Hourthunk
description: Hold a steady fall of blades along the open front so the foe may not close.

name: Murkshiv
description: Cast a blade into an approaching foe's lunge so his own reach is cut short.

name: Granite Throwtang
description: Scatter blades over the open ground so no point of it lets a foe stand secure.

name: Remorseless Throwgrip
description: Stand blades upright across the open ground so a foe's charge impales itself on the line.

name: Ponderous Spineweight
description: Hold the whole open ground by the steady reach of a stream of blades so none may enter.

name: Shivinsight
description: Hold a straight rod against the horizon to fix the bearing before the stance is set.

name: Rumblelodge
description: Speak the oath aloud on the draw so the voice holds the arm steady through release.

name: Novathunk
description: Fix the hips on the bearing and let only the arm travel so the line does not drift.

name: Leanvigil
description: Slow the breath under strain so the hand does not shake as the cast is made.

name: Granite Bladeflat
description: Pivot on the planted foot so the bearing stays on the foe through a full turn.

name: Ruinous Balanceblade
description: Throw with both bearing and oath held so the blade flies as straight as a pulled cord.

name: Hoarfrost Spinthrow
description: Pin the foe's drawing hand with a blade he swore not to see until it lands.

name: Evergreen Edgeflat
description: Roll the guard along the bearing to knock a flying blade off its straight line.

name: Intentthunk
description: Chain throws each on a separate sworn bearing so they fan through the foe's whole front.

name: Nova Lodge
description: Hold the hand unmoving under blows and drive a single qi-edged blade through armor.

name: Novashiv
description: Throw a chain of blades along one bearing to stand as a corridor of cutting lines.

name: Overpowering Thunk
description: Bind the foe's both arms with blades thrown along the bearing from three sides.

name: Lancing Pointguard
description: Throw once at the full strength of bearing and oath so the blade lands as sworn.

name: Balanceblade Respite
description: Wrap a cord round the sworn wrist so the oath is tied to the hand that throws.

name: Gust Spinetip
description: Throw by the wrist alone with a short quick flick that carries a straight blade.

name: Intent Hiltweight
description: Rest on the held oath between throws so the arm stays loose and the wrist stays quick.

name: Torrent Throwgrip
description: Take one short step on the sworn side to shift the line without breaking the wrist's set.

name: Rampaging Spinetip
description: Throw three blades in rapid order with a loose sworn wrist and no wasted motion.

name: Rending Spineweight
description: Snap the sworn wrist with a pulse of qi so the blade pierces light armor from afar.

name: Unconquered Bladeflat
description: Turn the sworn wrist to knock a blade aside and loose a throw out of the same turn.

name: Gyveslim
description: Pin a foe's sleeve to a tree with a gale-fast throw from the sworn wrist.

name: Ruinous Flight
description: Loose a rain of edges from the sworn wrist so the gale carries them over the foe's front.

name: Lot Flickthrow
description: Chain throws and recalls from one wrist so the same blades strike and return again.

name: Eviscerating Flight
description: Speak the oath and loose the strongest throw of the sworn wrist at the one foe named.
